snippet.title: The Twilight Project – First Look Teaser (Survival Horror Game)
snippet.description:
The Twilight Project is a third-person survival horror game where you play as a tourist who gets lost in a forgotten village sealed off from the outside world. As night falls, strange and terrifying creatures begin to appear and reality starts to shift into something far darker.
